dict.După ce ai emis factura, alegi „Da” la F: Once you have issued the invoice, choose "Yes" under Invoiced and enter its number; under Selected client you see how much is still to invoice for someone.
dict.Pentru consultanți, avocați, contabili,: For consultants, lawyers, accountants, programmers and anyone paid by the hour: each piece of work with the date, client, project and the from – to hours, with the break; you get the hours worked, the value at the usual rate or the row's own rate, and whether it is still to be invoiced (in yellow); on the right the billable hours, how much was invoiced and how much is still to invoice, in total and for a selected client.
dict.Tariful rândului se scrie doar când e al: Enter a row's rate only when it differs from the usual one; "No" under Billable = hours that are not paid.
dict.Un rând pe fiecare bucată de lucru: data: One row per piece of work: the date, the client, the hours (for example 9:00 and 12:30) and the break in minutes.
